phrase: Game festival judges, open-source coders, and an airline all said no to AI today. A chip maker invested another billion into it anyway.
phraseAlternatives: An airline, game judges, and open-source coders all pushed back against AI this week. A chip maker answered with another billion-dollar bet.
Communities keep rejecting AI code and AI agents, from game festivals to airline bookings. The money kept flowing the other way.
AI was turned away from a coding contest, an open-source project, and a flight booking today. A chip maker still bet a billion on it.
Three separate groups told AI 'not here' today: game judges, coders, and an airline. A chip maker told it 'here's another billion.'
alt: A human airline worker holds up a stop hand toward a small worried robot standing at a check-in counter holding out a ticket. In the background, a smaller company building sits off to the side under a chip-shaped funnel pouring coins onto its roof, labeled MORE MONEY.

brief.concept: Game judges, open-source coders, and an airline all drew a line against AI today, while a chip maker poured another billion dollars into the companies making it.
brief.metaphor: A row of gates and counters turning small AI robots away, right beside a company building getting showered with coins from a chip-shaped funnel.
